recipe.seed_bag: uniform probability mean of exact-C seeds 1, 7, 2026
recipe.dense_physics_r_blend: on R: exact_parent + 0.5 * (dense_physics_raw - exact_parent); on F: exact_parent

f_postbreak_preregistration.reason: The final formula changes F only through half of the already-fixed uniform seed-bag direction. No dense expert is applied to F.
f_postbreak_preregistration.on_fail: Candidate is ineligible and 2024 remains unopened.

development_application.candidate_direction: final recipe prediction minus exact component C

development_gate.G_dev: minimum full-score point gain across both years and all three baselines
development_gate.on_fail: Close recipe without training or reading any 2024 candidate.
development_gate.on_pass: Freeze all artifacts and formulas, then train 2024 exactly once for locked confirmation.
